meta.titre: Identifying the odd pronunciation out among similarly spelled words

sections.contenu_markdown: In English, the same letters can hide completely different sounds: spelling is not a reliable guide to pronunciation.

items: Basic phonetic symbols for English vowel sounds

sections.contenu_markdown: For each word, mentally pronounce the underlined letters and identify the phonetic sound they represent, ignoring the spelling itself. Compare the four sounds and identify the one that differs from the other three, even if all four words are spelled with the same letters.

sections.enonce_markdown: Find the odd one out: sound, shout, soup, cloud.

etapes.justification: Identify the actual sound, not the spelling.

sections.conclusion_markdown: 'Soup' is the odd word out, pronounced with /uː/ instead of /aʊ/.

items.erreur_markdown: Choosing the odd word out based on spelling difference rather than actual pronunciation.
items.pourquoi_faux: This type of exercise specifically tests pronunciation, which can differ even among identically spelled letter groups.
items.correction_markdown: Always say the words (even silently) to check the real sound, never rely on spelling alone.

items.enonce_markdown: Find the odd one out: book, food, look, good.
items.solution_markdown: food (pronounced /uː/, while the others are pronounced /ʊ/).

items_markdown: Spelling does not determine pronunciation in English
Always compare the actual phonetic sound of the underlined letters
